exercises.title: Define T0 and T1
exercises.objective: Distinguish one-directional and preferred-direction open separation.
success: T0 distinguishes points in at least one direction
T1 separates the first point from the second

exercises.title: Prove the implications and strictness
exercises.objective: Use Hausdorff to T1 to T0, Sierpiński, and infinite cofinite counterexamples.
success: T1 separates the first point from the second

checks.lean:
example {α : Type*} (τ : LeanCraftGame.Topology.MyTopology α) (h : T14.MyHausdorff τ) : T14.MyT1 τ := by
  intro x y hxy
  obtain ⟨U, V, hU, hV, hxU, hyV, hd⟩ := h x y hxy
  refine ⟨U, hU, hxU, ?_⟩
  intro hyU
  have hz : y ∈ U ∩ V := ⟨hyU, hyV⟩
  rw [hd] at hz
  exact hz
checks.message: A Hausdorff neighbourhood of `x` contains no point of the disjoint neighbourhood of `y`, so Hausdorff implies T1.

checks.lean:
example {α : Type*} (τ : LeanCraftGame.Topology.MyTopology α) (h : T14.MyT1 τ) : T14.MyT0 τ := by
  intro x y hxy
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hx, hy⟩ := h x y hxy
  exact ⟨U, hU, Or.inl ⟨hx, hy⟩⟩
checks.message: T1 supplies the preferred direction needed for one disjunct of T0.

checks.lean:
example : T14.MyT0 LeanCraftGame.Topology.sierpinski := by
  intro x y hxy
  cases x <;> cases y
  · exact (hxy rfl).elim
  · exact ⟨{true}, Or.inr rfl, Or.inr ⟨rfl, by simp⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨{true}, Or.inr rfl, Or.inl ⟨rfl, by simp⟩⟩
  · exact (hxy rfl).elim
checks.message: Singleton `{true}` distinguishes Boolean points in either order, so Sierpiński is T0.

checks.lean:
example : ¬ T14.MyT1 LeanCraftGame.Topology.sierpinski := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hf, ht⟩ := h false true (by decide)
  rw [LeanCraftGame.Topology.sierpinski_isOpen_iff] at hU
  rcases hU with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp_all
checks.message: No Sierpiński open set contains `false` while omitting `true`, so the space is not T1.
Infinite cofinite Nat is T1 by a general instance.

checks.lean:
example : ¬ T2Space (CofiniteTopology Nat) := by
  intro h
  exact @not_preirreducible_nontrivial_t2 (CofiniteTopology Nat) inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance h
checks.message: Infinite cofinite Nat is irreducible, so a Hausdorff structure would contradict nontriviality.

hints.hint: Use `∃ U, τ.IsOpen U ∧ (x ∈ U ∧ y ∉ U ∨ y ∈ U ∧ x ∉ U)` after `∀ x y, x ≠ y →`.
Use the same preferred-direction witness without the second disjunct.
Return two opens `U,V`, membership proofs `x ∈ U`, `y ∈ V`, and `U ∩ V = ∅`.
